day_titles.6: To Paro: Paro and Kyichu Lhakhang

1: Arrival at Bagdogra or Siliguri and transfer to Phuentsholing
Border formalities at the Bhutan Gate
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then north into the hills towards Thimphu
The Chukha dam and the Wang Chhu gorge on the way
Optional: the Zorig Chusum school of arts
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
3: Breakfast, then out into the capital
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
Tashichho Dzong and the takin preserve
4: Breakfast, then east over the Dochula pass
The hundred and eight chortens at the top
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
The long suspension bridge over the water
5: Breakfast in the warm Punakha valley
Gangtey Goemba on its low ridge
The crane valley spread out below
6: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
A guided round of the Paro valley
Kyichu Lhakhang, among the oldest temples in Bhutan
7: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
8: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Paro International for your flight home

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha and Paro with a day out at Gangtey. This is the full western circuit at a sensible pace.
expert.tip: The Gangtey day is the one to protect. Between November and February the black necked cranes are actually in the valley.

summary: 8 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, with 7 nights, daily breakfast and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing tour, the punakha sightseeing tour, the gangtey and the phobjikha valley, the paro sightseeing with kyichu lhakhang.
included: Included: 7 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro with daily breakfast; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing tour; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Gangtey and the Phobjikha valley; the Paro sightseeing with Kyichu Lhakhang; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
